create_repo_hf_model: create a new Hugging Face model repository with specified visibility and SDK settings
upload_file_to_hub: upload a local file to a Hugging Face Hub repository with automatic LFS handling
list_models_by_filter: list Hugging Face models filtered by tag, author, or pipeline task
download_model_weights: download a specific file from a Hugging Face model repository to local cache
create_inference_endpoint: create a cloud-hosted inference endpoint for a model with specified hardware and scaling config
